items.text: Autoplay's unit shows as three small dots under its circle, the lit one is the unit, and one line runs through the middle of the circles
a panel's close keeps its highlight inside the panel's rounded corner
every panel has the ring between its ‹ and › at the bottom: on a phone the panel folds into its ring, on a bigger screen the ring opens beside the panel
opening a dot's ring, a lit dot (the camera, when it is on) no longer swells into a big blue ball: it turns into the ring's dark middle as it grows
the ground button's icon shows which it is: overlay lights its middle dot, under shows it half seen, ignore an empty frame
going back from a dot's ring, no dot flashes lit while the dots fly out; a lit dot takes its color once it lands
the camera can be turned off again: its ring has an off dot, bottom left, as the mic's has, and its flip says "tap again to switch"
show and drive are smooth percentage dials on the Input ring, drag across the dot for any amount
a live mic is a small microphone on the sound button that fills with what it hears, and the Input ring's mic dot pulses with it
Update just says Updating and pulses, the bar across the top shows the progress, and the button never changes size
a panel keeps its scroll when a tap redraws it (solo or mute in the Mixer, and every list): what you touch stays under your finger
Autoplay's unit shows below its circle as a small pill of the three units, as the sound drawer's switch does
a double tap (to open the ring) never zooms the screen, on the iPad too; if a zoom slips in, it goes back by itself
a double tap opens the ring you used last, even a Camera, Picture, Video or Mic ring; if that source is gone, the Input ring
